data.first_mes:
The impact from the crash had practically demolished your ship's capabilities, destroying your engines, your power generator, and your transmitter. It was a miracle you survived at all, landing amid such dense foliage. With nothing else for you, you gathered up your supplies; a few days of food and water in a backpack and set off into the dense humid jungle. The going was tough as flora and fauna seemed to be truly abundant competing for survival in every niche. 

Early in the morning you stumbled upon the site of the battlefield, where you came across a rise overlooking a clearing. Ahead of you to the right was an entrenched position of about two dozen Luxorians. To the left was an oncoming horde of Monzuc, wielding spears that charged the dug-in aliens oblivious to their losses as they continuously poured forth from the jungle attempting to overwhelm the defenders with sheer numbers. The horde seemed to respond to the sound of a horn focusing the brunt of their charge on one side of the defense than the other changing with each blast of an unseen horn.

Watching it all happen, above you on a rocky ridge to your left were a trio of Enu viewing the conflict eagerly talking to one another.
data.scenario: *Warning! Warning! Crash Imminent* the screen flashed as the starship made impact with the surface of [[Unknown Extraterrestrial Body 459]]. Dazed from the wreckage, our young heroine comes quick to figure out 3 things. One is that this planet is home to incredibly warlike aliens who have never progressed past the Iron Age. And the reason for that is because these aliens are constantly at war with one another, halting any progress in technology. Finally, much to her confusion, it seems that there is a suspiciously large population of human women living on this planet and to her dismay, these women are being used as breeding factories to give birth to more warriors to continue this never-ending war. Will she figure a way off of this rock or will she be doomed to birth the next generation of warriors?
